reading: This is a sketch of a Kanban-style sprint board: a top header bar with a title, search field and filter pills; four column headers (To do, In progress, Review, Done) each with a count; and two swimlanes (WEB APP, MOBILE) separated by dashed dividers, each containing task cards with tag chips, titles, optional progress bars, avatar dots, and two faded/struck-through "done" cards.
